biotools.summary: BioCyc integrates sequenced genomes with predicted metabolic pathways for thousands of organisms, providing extensive bioinformatics tools and pathway-genome databases. The resource includes tools for comparative analysis and statistics, and features a growing collection of pathway-genome databases.
